subject: Television & Streaming
title: African Television's Rising Voice
description: A short lesson to help you apply African Television's Rising Voice.

hook.text: Nollywood, Nigeria's film and TV industry, produces more content than Hollywood.

buildup.text: Nigerian shows reach audiences across Africa and the diaspora.

discovery.text: South Africa's Queen Sono was Netflix's first African original series.

twist.text: African television is growing faster than any other regional market.

climax.text: African television is the next frontier.

punchline.text: The world's next TV powerhouse is a continent just getting started.

quiz.question: What makes Nollywood remarkable in the global entertainment industry?
options: It's the second-largest film industry in the world by volume, producing more content than Hollywood
